itemList.description:
Exhibition Stalls (10' x 10') Economy 
Exhibition Stall  10'-0" X 10'-0" (100 Sq.ft.) 4-Day Event Providing, erecting, maintaining and dismantling of temporary exhibition stall of size 10'-0" X 10'-0" (100 Sq.ft.), complete in all respects, including structural framework, German hangar tent roofing, cloth wall and ceiling cladding, frontage frill, flooring, electrical fittings, furniture, water supply, numbering, transportation, labour, erection, dismantling and all incidental works, as specified below and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Stall Size and Structural Framework Providing and erecting one exhibition stall of internal floor area 10'-0" X 10'-0" 100 Sq.ft. Front height shall be 12' 0" and rear height shall be 10'-0". Stall shall be fabricated using suitable MS tubular/pipe structural framework or approved equivalent, adequately braced and secured to withstand normal wind and site conditions. All structural members shall be properly aligned, levelled and securely connected. Necessary vertical posts, horizontal members, rafters, supports, bracing, clamps, fasteners and other accessories shall be provided. The structure shall be stable, safe and suitable for temporary exhibition use. All materials shall be of good quality and approved by the Engineer-in-Charge.  Roofing Providing and fixing waterproof German hangar tent fabric of approved make and quality over the complete roof area. Roofing shall be properly stretched, tensioned and securely fixed to the structural framework.The roofing material shall be waterproof, clean, durable and free from tears, holes and visible defects. Necessary overlaps, stitching, ropes, clamps, hooks, fasteners and supporting arrangements shall be included. The roof shall be adequately secured to prevent water leakage and sagging during the event.  Wall and Ceiling Cladding Providing and fixing good-quality white cloth/fabric to the back wall and both side walls of the stall. The complete ceiling shall also be covered with white cloth. Cloth shall be properly stitched, stretched and fixed to the framework. The fabric shall be clean, uniform and free from stains, tears and patches.  The cloth shall be fixed neatly without wrinkles, folds, sagging or loose portions. Necessary ropes, hooks, clips, stitching, supports and fixing accessories shall be included.  Frontage and Frill Providing and fixing good-quality decorative white/approved-colour frill of 3'-0" height continuously across the front of the stall. Frill shall be neatly stitched and properly fixed to the frontage framework. It shall be uniform in appearance and securely fastened throughout the event. All necessary cloth, stitching, fixing materials and labour shall be included.  Flooring Levelling, dressing and cleaning the existing floor/surface before erection of the stall. Providing and spreading good-quality green-coloured synthetic mat/carpet over the entire 100 Sq.ft. floor area. Mat shall be properly cut, joined and laid without wrinkles, folds or uneven portions. Necessary underlay, fixing tape or other accessories, wherever required, shall be included. Flooring shall be maintained in good and usable condition throughout the event.  Electrical Installation Providing and fixing electrical fittings in complete working condition, including wiring and connections: Tube light, 40 Watts 2 Nos. 3 Pin Socket point 1 No. Electrical wiring shall be carried out using suitable insulated wires/cables of approved quality. Necessary switches, holders, connectors, junctions, plug tops, conduits/casing, supports and other accessories shall be provided. All electrical connections shall be safe and properly insulated. The electrical installation shall be tested before handing over the stall. Connection to the available power  Furniture Providing and placing the following furniture in each stall: Table of size 6' 0" X 2' 0" 2 Nos. Plastic armed chairs 2 Nos. Chairs shall be provided with clean and good-quality cloth covering.

Fabricated Exhibition Stalls (Hi-Tech Stalls)
German Hanger / Main Exhibition Structure Providing and erecting a temporary German Hanger Tent structure of size approximately 280'-0" X 200'-0" (1 No.), having: Centre height not less than 24'-0" and side/end height not less than 20'-0". Separate fabricated steel/metal superstructure of adequate strength and stability. Good-quality, waterproof and fire-retardant tent fabric suitable for temporary exhibition purposes. Provision for adequate air circulation, aeration and ventilation at the top/end portions. Proper anchoring, bracing, supporting and securing arrangements against wind and other weather conditions. Complete erection, fixing, dismantling and removal after completion of the event. All required scaffolding, tools, tackles, fasteners, clamps, ropes, supports and accessories shall be included. . Lighting and Electrical Arrangements Providing and fixing temporary electrical arrangements including 400 W metal-halide lights  2 Nos. per 1,000 sq.ft. of exhibition area, suitably positioned for uniform illumination.  Providing adequate electrical cabling, distribution boards, MCBs, switches, connectors and necessary accessories.  Properly insulated and safely routed electrical wiring/cables.  Earthing and electrical safety arrangements as required.  Electrical installation shall be carried out by competent personnel and maintained throughout the 4-day event. Ceiling Fans Providing and fixing ceiling fans at approximately 1 No. for every 200 sq.ft. of covered exhibition area, including Fan suspension/support arrangement. Wiring, switches and necessary electrical accessories. Testing and commissioning. Maintenance during the entire event period.  Floor Preparation Providing and preparing the exhibition floor by: Levelling and dressing the existing floor/ground. Removing loose materials and making the surface suitable for exhibition stalls. Providing and spreading good-quality green-coloured synthetic mat/carpet over the entire required floor area. Proper joining, fixing and finishing of the mat to avoid unevenness, folds or trip hazards.  Hi-Tech / Octonorm Shell-Type Exhibition Stalls Providing and erecting 10'-0" X 10'-0" Hi-Tech Octonorm shell-type exhibition stalls within the German hanger structure, complete with aluminium/octonorm framework, panels and required accessories. Each stall shall be provided with the following:  Lighting and Electrical Points 3 Nos. spotlights per stall. No. 3-pin 5A socket.  No. 3-pin 16A socket. Complete wiring, switches, connectors and accessories. All electrical points shall be properly fixed and made operational.  Tables 2 Nos. tables, each of size 6'-0" X 2'-0".  Tables shall have suitable tops and all sides covered with good-quality cloth. Providing decorative cloth frills around the tables. Tables shall be clean, stable and in good condition.  Chairs 2 Nos. good-quality plastic armchairs per stall.  Chairs shall be clean and in good usable condition.  Name Board Providing and fixing acrylic sheet name board at the top/front portion of each stall. Name boards shall be of suitable size and thickness. Displaying/pasting the stall name in both Kannada and English. Lettering, size, font and content shall be as directed by the Engineer Name boards shall be properly aligned and securely fixed.  Stall Numbering Providing and fixing clearly visible stall numbering for all stalls using suitable printed/acrylic/vinyl display material, providing temporary water supply arrangements including Tools, tackles, machinery and  Event Period and Completion The exhibition is proposed for a period of 4 days.  Measurement The Hi-Tech Octonorm exhibition stall shall be measured and paid based on the number of completed 10'-0" X 10'-0" stalls actually erected and made ready for use,

Hiring Providing and Erecting Industrial Exhibition Stalls  20' X 20'
Providing, erecting, decorating, maintaining and dismantling industrial exhibition stalls of size 20'-0" X 20'-0" (400 Sq.ft.) each, complete in all respects, for a period of 4 days, including transportation, loading, unloading, erection and dismantling, as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge, with the following specifications: Stall Size and Structure: Providing and erecting each exhibition stall of size 20'-0" X 20'-0" (400 Sq ft.), with a front height of 12' 0" and rear height of 10'-0", using a structurally sound and stable MS/GI tubular framework of approved quality, properly anchored and braced to withstand normal wind and weather conditions. Roofing:Providing and fixing the roof with waterproof GI sheets of approved quality and suitable thickness, including all necessary supporting members, overlaps, screws, nuts, bolts, flashing and accessories, ensuring that the roof is completely leak-proof and suitable for the 4-day event. Wall Side Covering
Providing and fixing suitable side and rear wall panels/cladding using good-quality approved material, properly secured to the framework, with neat finishing and adequate provision for entry and ventilation. Flooring Providing a level and clean floor inside each stall, including suitable temporary flooring/platform wherever required, complete with necessary supporting framework and finishing, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Electrical Arrangements:
Providing electrical arrangements for each stall including: 2 Nos. 40 watt tube lights with fittings. 1 No. 3 pin socket with suitable switch and wiring. Concealed/protected electrical wiring with necessary switches, distribution arrangement, holders, cables and accessories. All electrical connections shall be properly insulated, safely secured and tested before handing over. Electricity shall be provided from the designated source as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Furniture:Providing the following furniture for each 20' X20' stall: 6'-0" X 2'-0" table  2 Nos. Plastic arm chairs  2 Nos. Furniture shall be clean, serviceable and in good condition throughout the event. Water Supply Arrangement Providing necessary temporary water-supply arrangements wherever required, including transportation of water through water tankers, loading/unloading, filling, pumping, laying of temporary hoses/pipes and distribution of water to the required location. The cost shall include all transportation, lead, lift, labour, tanker charges and incidental works required for maintaining adequate water supply during the event. Stall Numbering: Providing and fixing clearly visible stall numbers of suitable size and approved design at the front of each stall, including preparation, printing, fixing and removal after completion of the event. General Finishing and Maintenance The stalls shall be erected in a neat, safe and workmanlike manner. All joints, supports, roofing and coverings shall be properly secured. The contractor shall maintain the stalls, electrical fittings, furniture and water supply arrangements in good working condition throughout the 4-day event period. Transportation The rate shall include loading, unloading, transportation to and from the site, carriage, lead and lift, including all materials, structural members, GI sheets, electrical items, furniture, tools, equipment and labour required for erection and dismantling. Erection and Completion The complete erection of stalls shall be finished at least two day prior to commencement of the event, enabling inspection, allotment and handing over of individual stalls to exhibitors. Dismantling: After completion of the event, the contractor shall dismantle the stalls, remove all temporary structures, materials, debris and waste from the site and restore the area to a clean condition, all within the quoted rate. Safety:The contractor shall ensure proper structural stability and electrical safety.

Exhibition Stalls (15' X 20') Veterinary Stalls
Providing and erecting exhibition stalls of size 15'-0" X 20'-0" with the following facilities, complete in all respects as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge:
Structure & Roofing: Providing and erecting a suitable stall structure with front height of 12'-0" and rear height of 10'-0". The roof shall be covered with good-quality, waterproof German Hanger Tent, leaving suitable space at the top for proper ventilation and aeration. Wall & Ceiling Cladding: Covering all three sides and the ceiling of the stall with good-quality white cloth, properly stitched, stretched and fixed without wrinkles or sagging. Front Frill: Providing good-quality decorative frill of 3'-0" height along the front portion of the stall. Flooring: Properly levelling and preparing the floor and providing and spreading good-quality green-coloured synthetic mat/carpet over the entire stall area. Electrical Arrangements: Providing 2 Nos. 40-Watt tube lights and 1 No. 3-pin electrical socket in each stall, including necessary wiring, switches, fittings and connections, complete. Furniture: Providing 2 Nos. tables of size 6' X 2' and 2 Nos. plastic armchairs for each stall, including placement and removal after the event. Water Supply: Wherever required, providing necessary water supply arrangements, including transportation of water through tankers, loading/unloading, lifting and supply of water, complete as required for the event. Stall Numbering: Providing and fixing proper stall numbering/signage in a neat and clearly visible manner as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. Completion Schedule: The erection and all arrangements of the stalls shall be completed at least two days before commencement of the event to facilitate inspection, allotment and occupation of the stalls. Duration: The above arrangements shall be provided for the 4-day event, including erection before the event and dismantling after completion of the event. Veterinary Stalls: The stalls shall be specifically arranged and equipped for Veterinary Exhibition Stalls, with all necessary facilities as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The rate shall include all materials, labour, transportation, erection, fixing, electrical arrangements, flooring, furniture, water supply arrangements, maintenance during the event, dismantling and removal after the event, complete in all respects.

Hiring of Exhibition  Food Stalls 10' 0" X 10' 0" Providing, erecting, arranging and maintaining temporary exhibition food stalls of size 10' 0" X 10' 0" for a period of 4 days, complete in all respects, as per the following specifications and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge. Stall Size and Height Providing and erecting stalls of internal floor area 10' 0" X 10' 0" Sq.ft., with front height of 12' 0" and rear height of 10' 0", using suitable MS tubular angle framework of adequate strength, properly anchored and braced. Roofing Providing and fixing waterproof German hanger tent roofing of approved make and quality, properly stretched, fixed and secured to the supporting framework to prevent leakage during rain. The roofing shall be complete with necessary overlaps, fastening arrangements and provisions for proper drainage of rainwater.  Side Walls and Ceiling Providing and fixing good quality, clean and properly stitched white cloth fabric covering to the back and both side walls and ceiling, wherever required, properly tensioned and fixed without wrinkles or sagging. Front Fascia  Frill  Providing suitable front fascia frill of good-quality cloth, properly fixed along the front edge of the stall, including necessary stitching and fastening arrangements. Electrical Lighting Providing 2 Nos. 40 watt tube lights LED tube lights in each stall, complete with necessary wiring, switches, holders, connectors and electrical accessories, including connection from the nearest power source. All electrical installations shall be properly insulated and safely fixed. Tables Providing 2 Nos. tables of size 6' 0" X 2' 0" per stall, of good and sturdy quality, including transportation, placement and removal after completion of the event. Chairs Providing 2 Nos. plastic arm chairs per stall, in good condition, including transportation, placement and removal. Water Supply Arrangement For food stalls, wherever required, providing temporary water supply arrangements,, loading unloading, pumping lifting of water and distribution to the required location, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge..  Stall Numbering Providing and fixing stall numbering name plates prominently at the front of each stall, with clear and legible numbering, as per the layout and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge. Floor Preparation Dressing and levelling the existing ground floor within and around the stall area, wherever necessary, to provide a safe and reasonably level surface for the exhibitors food vendors, including minor filling and dressing.  Safety and Stability The entire stall structure shall be properly braced, anchored and secured against wind and weather conditions. All temporary electrical and structural arrangements shall be safe and maintained in good condition throughout the event. transportation, unloading, shifting, erection, fixing, dismantling and removal of all stall materials Maintenance During Event: The contractor shall maintain all stalls, roofing, cloth covering, furniture, lighting and other facilities in good and usable condition throughout the 4 day event period, including attending to minor repairs and replacements, if required. Completion Before Event All stalls shall be fully erected, furnished, numbered and made ready at least one day before commencement of the event, particularly the food stalls, to facilitate allotment and inspection by the University Engineer-in-Charge. Dismantling After completion of the event, the contractor shall dismantle and remove all temporary structures, furniture, electrical arrangements and other materials from the site and leave the area clean, without causing damage to existing  Measurement and Rate Unit Each Stall 10' 0" X 10' 0" Period 4 Days Rate shall be inclusive of Materials, labour, erection, dismantling,

Supplying, erecting, maintaining and dismantling temporary barricading of 4'-0" height using casuarina poles for the entire required length, for a 4-day event, complete in all respects.Supplying and erecting temporary barricading of 4'-0" overall height using good quality, straight and sound casuarina poles/stanchions, of adequate diameter and strength. Casuarina poles shall be securely fixed vertically into the ground at suitable intervals, generally not exceeding 4'-0" to 5'-0" centre to centre, or as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Providing two rows of horizontal casuarina poles continuously along the entire length of the barricading and securely tying/fixing them to the vertical stanchions with suitable binding wire, rope or other approved means. The barricading shall be properly aligned, level, stable and sufficiently rigid to withstand normal crowd movement and event-related use. The poles shall be free from excessive decay, cracks, bends or other defects and shall be in good usable condition. The barricading shall be provided at locations, lengths and alignments as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge, including all necessary shifting and minor adjustments at site. The barricading shall be completed and made ready at least two days before commencement of the event to facilitate allotment and marking of stalls. The item shall include loading, unloading, transportation, supplying, erection, fixing, binding, cutting, adjustment, shifting and dismantling, wherever required. The item shall also include hiring/material charges, labour charges, tools and tackles, HOM (hire of materials), transportation and all incidental charges required for completion of the work. The barricading shall be maintained in a safe and serviceable condition throughout the 4-day event period, including rectification of loose or damaged portions, if any. After completion of the event, the barricading shall be dismantled and the materials removed/stacked at the location directed by the Engineer-in-Charge, including clearing the site. No extra payment shall be made for overlaps, joints, cutting, wastage, binding materials, supports or other incidental works necessary for completing the barricading as specified. The entire work shall be executed complete in all respects as per the above specifications, site requirements and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Supplying, transporting, arranging and placing good quality VIP Executive Chairs on the designated Dias/Stage for a period of 4 days, suitable for use by Hon’ble Dignitaries, VIPs and other invited guests during the event.The chairs shall be of premium executive quality, sturdy and stable, with cushioned seat and backrest, proper armrests, good-quality upholstery/covering, adequate seating comfort and neat appearance suitable for an official function. Chairs shall be clean, properly maintained and free from damage, stains, tears or defects.Supply/hiring of required number of VIP Executive Chairs as per the direction of the Engineer-in-Charge. Transportation of chairs to and from the event venue. Loading, unloading, shifting and handling of chairs at site. Proper placement and alignment of chairs on the Dias/Stage as per the seating arrangement approved by the Engineer-in-Charge. Providing chairs sufficiently in advance for stage preparation and final arrangement. Cleaning, wiping and checking of all chairs before placement and maintaining them in good condition throughout the 4-day event. Daily inspection and rearrangement/replacement of any damaged or defective chair during the event. Labour charges for handling, arranging, shifting and removal of chairs. Hiring charges, transportation charges, labour charges and all other incidental charges shall be deemed to be included in the quoted rate. After completion of the event, dismantling/removal, shifting, loading and transportation of the chairs shall also be included. The chairs shall be kept in good condition and protected from damage during the entire event period. The work shall be completed as per the programme schedule and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing, erecting, hiring and maintaining temporary toilet units of size 4'-0" X 4'-0" for a period of 4 days for the event, complete in all respects, including transportation, erection, dismantling and shifting, as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.Structure: Providing and erecting temporary toilet cubicles of internal size 4'-0" X 4'-0", fabricated using rigid panels of suitable thickness, including supporting framework, vertical supports, horizontal members and necessary fasteners. Roofing and Side Covering: Providing GI sheet roofing and enclosing all sides with good-quality GI sheets, properly fixed to the supporting framework to ensure privacy, stability and protection from rain. Door: Providing and fixing a suitable GI sheet/PVC door of adequate size with hinges, handle, locking arrangement and inside latch, complete. Floor & Raised Platform: Properly levelling and compacting the ground and providing a raised platform using bricks and cement concrete/mortar, including necessary finishing to ensure a firm, hygienic and washable floor. Sanitary Fixture: Providing and fixing Orissa Pan (Indian Water Closet  IWC) of approved quality, complete with necessary trap, connectors and sanitary fittings. Water Supply: Providing temporary water supply pipeline with necessary PVC/HDPE pipes, bends, sockets, valves and taps, including all connections required for functioning of the toilets. Water Storage: Providing suitable water storage tank of adequate capacity, with necessary inlet, outlet, overflow and connecting pipe arrangements for continuous water availability during the event. Wastewater Disposal: Connecting each toilet to a properly constructed/arranged soak pit/septic pit, including sanitary pipelines, traps, joints and all necessary fittings. The pit shall be provided with a properly secured cover to prevent accidents, foul smell and access to the waste. Sanitary Drainage: Providing and fixing all necessary sanitary lines from the toilet to the disposal pit, including excavation, laying, jointing, testing and refilling wherever required. Cleaning and Maintenance: Providing dedicated toilet attendant(s) during the entire 4-day event for regular cleaning, washing and maintenance of the toilets. Cleaning shall be carried out at least once every hour and whenever required, including removal of waste, washing of floor and sanitary fixtures and maintaining proper hygiene. Water Filling: Regular filling/replenishment of water storage tanks and ensuring continuous availability of water throughout the event period. Cleaning Materials: Rate shall include supply and use of necessary cleaning materials such as disinfectant, bleaching powder, phenyl/toilet cleaner, brushes, brooms, mops, buckets, gloves, waste collection arrangements and other consumables required for proper maintenance. Transportation: Rate shall include loading, transportation, unloading, shifting and positioning of all toilet structures, sanitary fixtures, water tanks, pipelines and other materials to and from the event site. Erection & Dismantling: The temporary toilet structures shall be completely erected, tested and made ready for use at least two days before commencement of the event. After completion of the event, the structures shall be dismantled and removed from the site, including clearing the area. Safety & Stability: All structures shall be securely anchored/braced and shall be stable, safe and suitable for continuous public use. No sharp edges, loose sheets or unsafe projections shall be permitted. Complete in all respects: The quoted rate shall be inclusive of all materials, labour, transportation, loading/unloading, erection, dismantling, hiring charges, tools and tackles, water arrangements, sanitary fittings, drainage arrangements, cleaning and maintenance, attendant charges, HOM (hire/handling of materials), overheads, and all other incidental charges required for satisfactory completion of the work

Providing, supplying, erecting and maintaining temporary urinal structures of suitable size using good quality GI sheets for roofing, rear and side portions, including providing necessary partition panels between individual urinal stalls. The structure shall be properly supported with suitable MS/GI framework, poles, clamps, fasteners and other required accessories to ensure stability and safety throughout the event period. Structure: Providing and erecting temporary urinal enclosure using GI sheets of approved quality, including roofing and side/rear covering, properly supported on suitable MS/GI framework. Partitions: Providing GI sheet partitions between individual urinal stalls at uniform intervals, with sufficient privacy and proper spacing. Urinal Fixtures: Supplying and fixing good-quality long-stall urinals at regular/equal intervals, complete with necessary fittings, traps, connectors and flushing arrangements. Water Supply: Providing temporary water supply arrangement with required water storage tank, pipelines, taps/valves and connections for flushing and cleaning purposes. Wastewater Disposal: Providing necessary outlet pipes, drainage lines, traps and connections from the urinals to the designated sewage/soak pit, ensuring proper disposal without leakage or stagnation. Floor Arrangement: Providing a properly levelled and suitable floor/platform with necessary slope towards the drainage outlet for easy washing and disposal of wastewater. Cleaning & Maintenance: Supplying water and carrying out cleaning, washing and hygienic maintenance of the urinal structure once every hour during the event hours for all 4 days, including removal of accumulated waste and maintaining the facility in clean and usable condition. Transportation & Handling: Including loading, transportation, unloading, shifting, placement, erection and dismantling/return transportation of the hired urinal structure and all associated materials. Labour: Including all skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled labour required for transportation, erection, plumbing, maintenance, cleaning, washing and dismantling. Materials: All GI sheets, framework, urinal fixtures, pipes, fittings, valves, clamps, fasteners, water tanks, cleaning materials and other necessary accessories shall be provided/hired by the agency and shall be in good condition. Completion Schedule: The complete urinal structure shall be transported and erected at the designated location at least two days before commencement of the event for inspection and approval by the Engineer-in-Charge. Safety & Hygiene: The agency shall ensure that the structure is stable, leak-proof, hygienic and safe for public use throughout the event period. Dismantling: After completion of the 4-day event, the agency shall dismantle and remove the temporary structure and clear the site without causing damage to the existing campus/property. Approval: The location, size, number of urinal stalls, layout, materials and arrangements shall be as directed and approved by the Engineer-in-Charge

Supplying, transporting, placing and hiring of good quality 6'-0" X 2'-0" size wooden/steel tables for use during the event for a period of 4 days, including shifting and positioning of tables at the required locations as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.Size: 6'-0" length X 2'-0" width, with suitable height of approximately 2'-6". Type: Good quality wooden or steel-framed table with a sturdy and stable construction. Table Top: Smooth, level and rigid surface, free from cracks, bends, sharp edges, loose portions or other defects. Frame: Strong and stable MS steel/wooden frame capable of safely supporting the required display/event materials. Finish: Table shall be clean, properly finished and in good usable condition, without rust, broken portions or damaged surfaces. Safety: All corners and edges shall be properly finished to avoid injury to users. Transportation: The rate shall include loading, transportation to the event site, unloading, shifting and placing at the designated locations. Arrangement: Tables shall be arranged and repositioned as required for the event, as per the instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge. Maintenance: The agency shall ensure that all tables remain clean, stable and serviceable throughout the 4-day event period and shall replace any damaged or unsuitable table immediately. Dismantling & Removal: After completion of the event, the tables shall be dismantled/collected and removed from the site, including loading and transportation. Deployment: All tables shall be supplied and positioned at least two days before commencement of the event for inspection and necessary arrangements.

Supplying, providing and placing good quality table cloth of size 8'-0" X 3'-0" for covering tables during the event for a period of 4 days, including stitching, hemming, ironing, transportation, loading and unloading, spreading and properly placing the table cloth over the tables, and removal after completion of the event.The table cloth shall be made of good quality, clean, durable and stain-free cloth/fabric of approved colour and quality, with properly finished edges and sufficient drop on all sides for neat and uniform appearance. The cloth shall be properly washed/cleaned, ironed and free from wrinkles, tears, stains and defects before use. It shall be suitable for repeated handling during the event and shall be maintained in clean and presentable condition throughout the event period.The rate shall be inclusive of supply/hiring charges, stitching and finishing, transportation, loading and unloading, labour charges, laying/placing, removal, cleaning and all incidental charges, complete in all respects as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing, supplying, transporting, arranging and spreading good quality moulded plastic chairs with arms at the designated programme/event area, including all necessary loading, unloading, transportation, handling, placement and shifting of chairs as required.Chairs shall be made of good quality, durable, UV-resistant moulded plastic, suitable for outdoor and indoor use. Chairs shall be armless moulded Wait user requested with arms  use integral armrests. Chairs shall be of uniform size, design and colour, clean, presentable and free from cracks, breaks, stains, deformation or other defects. Chairs shall have adequate strength and load-bearing capacity suitable for use by adults during public functions/programmes. Supplying, transporting, providing and fixing good quality, clean, uniformly woven white cloth side walls of 10'-0" height at various locations of the Krishi Thotagarike Mela site, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Supplying, transporting, unloading, spreading and maintaining good quality synthetic floor mats/carpets at different locations of the Krishi Thotagarike Mela programme area for a period of 4 days, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Supplying and laying good quality plywood sheets over existing drainage/open drain at the Registration Counter and other required locations during Krishi Thotagarike Mela.Supplying, transporting, cutting, fitting and laying good quality, durable and water-resistant plywood sheets, of suitable thickness (minimum 18 mm, or as approved by the Engineer-in-Charge), over existing open drains/drainage channels at the Registration Counter and other locations as required during the 4-day Krishi Thotagarike Mela.The plywood shall be of adequate strength and properly supported to withstand the movement of visitors, staff and event personnel. Providing, erecting, hiring and dismantling of German Hanger Pandal of size 63'-0" X 200'-0" for the Main Stage/Programme Area for Krishi Thotagarike Mela for 4 days, complete in all respects as per the directions of the Engineer-in-ChargeStructure: Providing and erecting a structurally sound, stable and weather-resistant German Hanger type aluminium/steel framed structure of overall size 63'-0" width X 200'-0" length, with adequate intermediate supports at approximately 4.0 m intervals or as required for structural stability. Erection Schedule: The complete German Hanger structure, including roof, backside screen, side walls and required partitions, shall be fully erected and made ready at least two days before commencement of the 4-day event for inspection and approval by the Engineer-in-Charge. Duration: The structure shall remain erected and maintained in good, safe and usable condition throughout the 4-day Krishi Thotagarike Mela. Dismantling: After completion of the event, the agency shall dismantle and remove the complete structure.

Hiring, supplying and fixing of high-quality white backdrop cloth of supreme quality for the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, loading, unloading, erection, fixing, removal and all necessary labour and accessories.The backdrop cloth shall be new/clean, wrinkle-free, opaque and of uniform white colour, suitable for stage and programme areas. Hiring, supplying and placing of good quality Tepai of size 3'-0" X 2'-0" for use at the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, loading, unloading, placement and removal after completion of the event.The Tepai shall be of good quality, sturdy, clean and in good usable condition, with a stable and properly finished frame/support. Hiring, supplying, erecting and providing backdrop scaffolding with high-quality white cloth for the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, erection, fixing, maintenance and dismantling after completion of the event.The backdrop scaffolding shall be fabricated using good quality MS/GI pipes or suitable steel tubular sections, of adequate diameter and thickness, properly joined and braced to provide a rigid, stable and safe structure. Hiring, supplying and spreading good quality shade net at various locations for providing shade and temporary flooring arrangements during the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, loading, unloading, spreading, fixing, shifting and removal after completion of the event.The shade net shall be of good quality, clean, durable and suitable for temporary outdoor use, of adequate GSM and appropriate shade percentage as required for the particular location. Hiring, supplying and arranging good quality banquet chairs for the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, loading, unloading, placement, shifting and removal after completion of the event.The banquet chairs shall be of good quality, sturdy, clean and in good condition, suitable for use by dignitaries, officials, exhibitors and visitors. Providing, supplying and fixing good quality waterproof tarpaulin (Tarpaulin) on both side walls of the stage/dais for the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, loading, unloading, cutting, stitching, fixing, maintenance and removal after completion of the event.The tarpaulin shall be of good quality, heavy-duty, waterproof, UV-resistant and suitable for outdoor temporary event use, of adequate thickness and strength. Hiring, supplying and positioning of mobile toilet units near the stage/dais for the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, including transportation, placement, water filling, cleaning, sanitation, maintenance and removal after completion of the event.The mobile toilet unit shall be of good quality, clean, hygienic, leak-proof and suitable for outdoor event use, with adequate ventilation, proper flooring, roof and a lockable door. Providing, printing, supplying, erecting and fixing high-quality Flex banners with suitable metal frames at different locations such as stage backdrop, entrance arches and other designated areas for the Krishi Thotagarike Mela for a period of 4 days, as per the approved designs, dimensions, artwork, colour scheme and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge.
